mapper.update: update provider_wallet set pending_settlement = pending_settlement + #{netAmount}, version = version + 1 where provider_id = #{providerId} and version = #{version}

update provider_wallet set pending_settlement = pending_settlement - #{netAmount}, balance = balance + #{netAmount}, total_income = total_income + #{netAmount}, version = version + 1 where provider_id = #{providerId} and version = #{version} and pending_settlement >= #{netAmount}
update provider_wallet set balance = balance + #{amount}, version = version + 1 where provider_id = #{providerId} and version = #{version}
